content.title: SaverOne Expands IP Portfolio With New US Patent, Stock Gains
content.summary: SaverOne 2014 Ltd. (NASDAQ:SVRE), a transportation safety technology company, has been awarded its 13th patent by the United States Patent and Trademark Office (USPTO). Issued on February 18, 2025, under patent number 12,231,899, the patent covers SaverOne’s system designed to restrict mobile phone use while driving. content.summary: SaverOne 2014 Ltd. ADR ( (SVRE) ) has shared an update. content.title: SaverOne Strengthens IP with New US Patent for Driver Safety Technology
content.summary: SaverOne 2014 Ltd. ADR ( (SVRE) ) has issued an announcement.
